The [[Charged Stormcaller weapons]] set is a set of weapons released with the [[Jormag Rising]] chapter of Living World Season 5.

[[Salvage|Salvaging]] a weapon from this set will give 10 {{item icon|Memory of Otter}}, in addition to the standard exotic salvage materials. Salvaging with a [[Research Kit]] yields only [[Research Note]]s, however.

== Acquisition ==
=== [[Recipe]]s ===
Recipes are contained in {{item icon|Dominion Crafting Box}} and {{item icon|Frost Legion Crafting Box}}.

=== [[Crafting]] ===
Once the recipes are unlocked, weapons can be crafted by {{artificer}}[[Artificer]]s, {{Huntsman}}[[Huntsman|Huntsmen]], and {{weaponsmith}}[[Weaponsmith]]s. All weapons require 2 {{item icon|Stormcaller Core}}s, 2 {{item icon|Amalgamated Draconic Lodestone}}s, 10 {{item icon|Glob of Ectoplasm}}, and an exotic inscription.

=== Trading ===
[[Charged Stormcaller weapons]] can be sold and bought through the [[Trading Post]].
